subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should existing `settings.retry.provider.maxRetries` continue to mean provider-SDK request retries, or may it intentionally become a budget for complete primary-to-fallback reply cycles?
rationale: The branch must prevent retries inside the released session-lock window, but mapping the existing setting to the outer fallback loop changes an existing user-facing retry contract rather than making a purely mechanical safety repair.

options.title: Preserve configured retry semantics
options.body: Implement a lock-safe retry owner that retains the existing setting’s request-level/provider behavior and prove configured primary and fallback paths before merge.

options.title: Approve whole-cycle semantics
options.body: Accept the changed retry scope only with explicit upgrade documentation and proof of the resulting provider order, retry count, latency, and billing exposure.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured retry semantics
recommendation.body: Implement a lock-safe retry owner that retains the existing setting’s request-level/provider behavior and prove configured primary and fallback paths before merge.
